name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2025-05-19, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.74 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
